Box office collection

[edit | edit source]

The List of highest-grossing Telugu films released in 2025, by worldwide box office gross revenue, are as follows: The rank of the films in the following table depends on the estimate of worldwide collections as reported by organizations classified as green by Wikipedia.The total collection of movies is 1580 crores.[1][a] There is no official tracking of domestic box office figures within India.
